# The advisory lock methods of DB and Tx become free functions in github.com/azrtydxb/momo/advisory; each takes the transaction (a *momo.Tx) as its second argument.
Tx.AdvisoryXactLock XactLock
Tx.AdvisoryXactLockString XactLockString
Tx.TryAdvisoryXactLock TryXactLock
Tx.TryAdvisoryXactLockString TryXactLockString
DB.AdvisoryXactLock XactLock
DB.AdvisoryXactLockString XactLockString
DB.TryAdvisoryXactLock TryXactLock
DB.TryAdvisoryXactLockString TryXactLockString
